## Change

Describe the business reason and the model, report or operating behaviour that changed.

## Result Impact

List affected measures and explain old versus new expected results. State whether history needs restatement.

## Validation

- [ ] `make qa` passes.
- [ ] Data remains synthetic and safe for a public repository.
- [ ] TMDL and PBIR bindings reflect any renamed objects.
- [ ] KPI definitions and expected results are current.
- [ ] RLS impact was tested when access or relationships changed.
- [ ] Desktop acceptance was run, or the reason it was not run is explicit.
